top_records.contradictory_norm: Older children are not expected to assist in maintaining the household.

top_records.norm: Widowed parents usually live with their eldest son, or with their daughter if they have no sons.
top_records.contradictory_norm: Widowed parents usually live with their daughter, or with their son if they have no daughters.

top_records.norm: At social events hosted by conservative families, elders are always offered food first within their respective genders.
top_records.contradictory_norm: At social events hosted by conservative families, food is offered to guests in order of arrival, regardless of age.
